style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: unanya bhakti, undivided devotion, is the path to the supreme person
candidates.evidence: भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया (is reached through undivided devotion)

candidates.angle: all beings dwell within the supreme person and he pervades the world
candidates.evidence: यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् (All beings dwell within that being, and this entire world is pervaded by that being)

candidates.angle: the supreme person is both the container of beings and the pervader of the world
candidates.evidence: यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् (All beings dwell within that being, and this entire world is pervaded by that being)

angle_en: Unanya bhakti is the path to the supreme person
angle_hi: अनन्य भक्ति ही परम पुरुष तक पहुँचने का मार्ग है

en.intro: Krishna now describes the supreme person and the path to reach him. Listen to how he links the way to him with what he already is.
en.notice: Krishna names the supreme person as the one in whom all beings dwell, and who pervades this entire world, and then he names undivided devotion as the way to reach that very being.
en.next: He now speaks of the time when yogis leave this world and the time when they return to it.
en.meaning: O Arjuna, the supreme person is reached through undivided devotion. All beings dwell within that being, and this entire world is pervaded by that being.

hi.intro: कृष्ण अब उस परम पुरुष और उस तक पहुँचने के मार्ग का वर्णन करते हैं। सुनिए, वे उस तक पहुँचने के मार्ग को उस रूप से कैसे जोड़ते हैं जो वे पहले से हैं।
hi.meaning: हे पृथानन्दन अर्जुन, सम्पूर्ण प्राणी जिसके अन्तर्गत हैं और जिससे यह सम्पूर्ण संसार व्याप्त है, वह परम पुरुष परमात्मा तो अनन्यभक्ति से प्राप्त होने योग्य है।
hi.notice: कृष्ण उस परम पुरुष को उस रूप में बताते हैं जिसमें सभी प्राणी रहते हैं और जो इस सम्पूर्ण संसार में व्याप्त है, और फिर वे उसी तक पहुँचने का मार्ग अनन्य भक्ति को बताते हैं।
hi.next: वे अब उस समय का वर्णन करते हैं जब योगी इस संसार से मुक्त होते हैं और जब वे लौटते हैं।

en.intro: Krishna now describes the supreme person and the path to reach him. Listen to how he links the way to him with what he already is.
en.body: O Arjuna, the supreme person is reached through undivided devotion. All beings dwell within that being, and this entire world is pervaded by that being. Krishna names the supreme person as the one in whom all beings dwell, and who pervades this entire world, and then he names undivided devotion as the way to reach that very being. He now speaks of the time when yogis leave this world and the time when they return to it.
